## Advisory Roles

* Accessibility Customer Advisory Board Member, MathWorks, 2023 - Present: providing feedback on MATLAB accessibility features, generative AI integration, and assistive technology compatibility.

* Accessibility Advisory Member and Co-Designer, Microsoft Visual Studio Code (VS Code) Accessibility Team, 2022 - Present: collaborating on screen reader support, terminal buffer, semantic audio cues, Copilot, and Jupyter Notebook accessibility.

* Advisory Board Member, "Making is for Everyone: Learning within Library Makerspaces for Youth with Disabilities" (IMLS National Leadership Grant #LG-252323-OLS-22), 2022 - Present.

* Accessibility Consultant (Faculty Affiliate and Senior Personnel), NSF-funded Delta GPU High-Performance Computing Project, National Center for Supercomputing Applications (NCSA), Fall 2022 - Present.
